headline.text: L1 S2 PRS jar pallets on *rework hold* — packed in wrong box size, spec mismatch on final pallet configuration.

summary: One active hold — L1 S2 PRS dark chocolate jars packed in wrong boxes, pallets moved to rework. Three quality issues: L2 FFS checkweigher rejecting good-weight pouches, L1 S3 running 20% over centerline speed with high doubles, L3 ML1 temper instability. Three sanitation gaps at L3 ML4: depositor tank recleaning, caramel chain buildup, chocolate-filled drains.

holds.title: PRS dark chocolate jars — wrong packaging
holds.summary: Pallets packed in 40402 boxes instead of specified 41059; final pallet configuration does not meet spec for box size, row count, or jar count — moved to rework pending disposition.
holds.status: On hold for rework — Quality approved temporary use of wrong boxes but flagged final pallets as non-compliant.

quality.title: S3 running 20% over centerline speed
quality.summary: Line found running at 72 rows/min instead of 60; most bed centerlines out of compliance, high rate of doubles, triples, and quadruples observed — brought back to centerline by Quality.
quality.status: Resolved — centerlines restored by 08:56, adjustments documented.

quality.title: FFS checkweigher rejecting correct-weight pouches
quality.summary: Checkweigher repeatedly kicked all pouches as underweight despite bags containing correct count (10 bars each); maintenance adjusted, line restarted multiple times through first shift.
quality.status: Resolved after maintenance adjustments — line ran stable by mid-shift.

quality.title: ML1 temper instability
quality.summary: Temper repeatedly dropped out of range throughout day; multiple pauses for adjustment and recovery, glycol below setpoint observed overnight.
quality.status: Ongoing — line running but temper required frequent intervention; root cause unknown.

quality.title: ML1 Donner 1 belt worn and damaged
quality.summary: Belt wear and damage discovered during 3rd shift cleaning; maintenance notified.
quality.status: Open — flagged for maintenance action Monday.

quality.title: S2 jar weight check — low weight with incorrect data
quality.summary: Weight check found jars low with incorrect data entry against spec; team corrected immediately.
quality.status: Resolved on shift — corrected before further production.

sanitation.title: ML4 Depositor 2 tank recleaning
sanitation.summary: QA inspection at 15:46 flagged areas of tank 2 for recleaning; second inspection cleared at 16:53 after rework, ATP passed.
sanitation.status: Resolved — recleaned and ATP cleared same shift.

sanitation.title: ML4 caramel buildup on chain
sanitation.summary: Considerable caramel buildup found on chain during shift changeover inspection; flagged for cleaning.
sanitation.status: Being addressed — cleaning in progress per Preston's comment.

sanitation.title: ML4 drains full of chocolate
sanitation.summary: Drains found full of chocolate during 3rd shift cleaning at 00:57; FSQA flagged for MSS schedule review.
sanitation.status: Cleaned same shift — Jorel recommended adding to regular maintenance schedule.

opportunities.text: Review packaging component verification at S2 job startup — based on PRS jars running 2,000+ pieces in wrong boxes before the mismatch was caught, requiring rework hold.
Review shift handoff procedures for S3 centerline compliance — based on line found running 20% over speed with bed settings out of spec at start of 1st shift.
Consider adding ML4 drain cleaning to the master sanitation schedule on a fixed frequency — based on chocolate-filled drains found overnight that required unscheduled cleaning.
